title: leucanthemum tenuifolium
intro: Leucanthemum tenuifolium, commonly known as the Narrow-leaved Oxeye Daisy or Mountain Daisy, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Leucanthemum tenuifolium include its use as a diuretic, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory agent, which can help to relieve respiratory issues, reduce inflammation, and promote digestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
